### Latency hiding: TTFT if each retrieval took L ms

The measured retrieval here is ~1 ms (in-process index), so both systems start answering within a few ms. With a production retrieval stack (remote vector DB + reranker) every query costs tens to hundreds of ms. Replaying the same traces with a simulated per-query latency L shows how much of it the streaming controller hides (speculative queries fired while the user is still talking finish before they stop):

| Per-query retrieval latency L | Batch RAG TTFT p50 / p95 (ms) | Kairos TTFT p50 / p95 (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| 50 ms | 52.7 / 54.7 | 2.8 / 54.2 |
| 150 ms | 152.7 / 154.7 | 2.8 / 154.2 |
| 400 ms | 402.7 / 404.7 | 2.8 / 404.2 |
